lines.text: My eyes open.
The clear sky stretches out before me.
I glance around, scanning the surroundings.
All I can see are white buildings.
In the corner of my eye, a black smudge comes into view.
I turn my head.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Oh. Have you come to, Young Man?

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Wow! H-he's really awake.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: See? I told you he isn't normal.
... You look like a bunch of vampires bathing in blood.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Well, we're not going to suck your blood, so don't worry.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: ... Although we've sucked something else from you.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: Ehem...
You're a new face.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: I'm Bahamut.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: I'm the brain of the Four Beasts. You'll do well to remember that.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: You see these glasses and book? They're proof of my brilliant intellect.
You're holding the book upside down, genius.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: Well, this genius will spell it out for you. You won't be able to fathom the difficulty of reading a book upside down.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: Yet I'm accomplishing this laborious task. Therefore, I am smart!

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Can someone get this doofus to shut her mouth? They've just met and she's already made a fool of herself.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Just leave her be. There's no way to make herself less of a fool anyway.

... Did Ziz save me? 
I'm pretty sure that I was thrown off of Whaley.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Uh... no.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: I wouldn't go that far to save even Levi and Behemoth.
Then who?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Foul creature.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: I, the ever-astute Bahamut, will inform you.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: You fell.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: When we discovered you, your legs, arms, and waist were all bent into impossible angles.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: Even your neck was twisted.
What...?

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: Thanks to my formidable intelligence, I know that the human skeleton consists of 370 bones.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: That is what you think, and I respect your opinion, Levi.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: It is neither shameful nor a crime to be ignorant. May you continue to fumble and grow from your failures.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Ugh... for goodness' sake.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Hahaha.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: According to my estimates, your entire skeleton was shattered into over 500 pieces.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: To put it in terms you can understand, your bones were utterly pulverized.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: Since you weren't dead, I brought you here. And with my boundless wisdom, I decided to bury you.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: But Levi and Behemoth insisted we wait and see.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: And then you awoke.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: In perfect health.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: In my astute judgment, your waking is akin to being resurrected from the dead.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I figured you were no ordinary human, but I didn't expect it to be this extreme.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Are you even human, I wonder?
I've been asking myself that lately, too.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: Then continue to ponder. Think on it, then despair, and then grow.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Would someone PLEASE shut her up?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Hmm, it's done. Let's get up.
*Splash*
The Four Beasts rise from the Dark Matter bath.
Leviathan stretches out broadly.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text:
We should have used this from the get-go. 
If only we'd known how well this would work.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: We had no way of knowing things would end up like this, so there was nothing we could have done. Our strategy up until now has been self-preservation and biding our time.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: S-so, are we really going to start now?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Of course. There's no reason to wait any longer.
The Four Beasts gaze at the Dark Matter bath they had been soaking in.
Dense concentrations of Dark Matter cascade like a waterfall into the tub.
Upon a closer look, it seems to be thicker than ordinary Dark Matter.
I lift my head.
A massive black sphere hangs above, like a moon. From it, dense Dark Matter spills forth.
I take it this is some kind of filtered and refined, highly concentrated Dark Matter?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Yeah, that's right.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: This Dark Matter is made from only the finest ingredients.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: We call it the Furnace.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: It's meticulously maintained using the highest quality of materials, with nothing impure mixed in.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: In other words, this is filled with Dark Matter that's the crème de la crème.
I take it this "crème de la crème" is what helped revive you as well?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: We wanted to hold off on using it for as long as possible, but we were pretty badly injured too.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: The final battle is nigh, so it stands to reason that we should prepare ourselves.
Leviathan, if you work with us—

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Silence. We're not having this conversation.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: We will use this to create the Queen, strike down the Offsprings, and then create our own world.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Whether you're working with the Offsprings or not is of little importance.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: It took us long enough, but we've finally realized a simple fact: If we wipe them all out, we won't have anything to worry about.
We won't betray you.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Right, right. I got it.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Bahamut. Give that to Ziz.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: All right.
Bahamut hands over a small bottle to Ziz.
Is that some kind of energy drink? Do you pour that in too? So you won't get tired?
What? Why'd everyone go quiet all of a sudden?

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: I, the perspicacious Bahamut, will explicate.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: ... Right. It might be better if you explain.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Y-yeah... that's right.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I-is there any reason we should even expla—

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: This is your essence.
What?

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: Allow me to repeat my intelligent self. This is your essence.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: Something from deep inside your body. You can consider it the very source of life.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: Perhaps I shall express it in more poetic terms, since I have a proclivity for literary refinement.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: This is the seed from which life springs.
Hold up.
I grope at my pants.
Bahamut nods her head.
Wait a minute! Y-you mean that's my...?

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: That's right.
But how?!
I-I don't remember anything?

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: We extracted it when you were unconscious.
Extract? Don't tell me you...?!

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: We used a needle.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: Injected it deep into your body.
No...

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: And sucked it out.
Argggh!

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: Just like that.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: A rather simple task for a surgical genius such as myself, who is well-versed in anatomy.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: However, during the procedure, the organ did undergo a sudden expansion...
Stop talking!
I won't forgive any of you for this...!

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: We do apologize for causing you any undue stress.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: But you must understand, we need it.
Why do you need that?!

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Whoa. Try to calm down.
Would you be able to calm down if someone took your... You know!

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: I wouldn't know... would I?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: ... Ziz.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Hurry up and put it in.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Oh, yeah.
Ziz flies up to the black sphere and throws the vial at it.
She then spreads her wings even wider.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Should I put in the other thing as well?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Yeah.
Ziz's wings writhe.
*Whoosh*
From her wings, a headless Rapi emerges.
What the...?
Rapi's body slips into the black sphere and disappears.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I told you before, didn't I?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: If a core is wrapped in Dark Matter, a new Rapture is born.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: The Rapi that Ziz picked up turned out to have two cores.
Where and how did you get that?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I don't know. I told you, Ziz picked it up.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: It's the first time we've seen anything like it. Definitely one of a kind.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: It was the right call to hold off on putting in any other cores until now.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Now that we've got a suitable core, along with your... contribution...

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: There's no reason to put it off any longer.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Now, the time has come for the Queen to be born.
For her to be born...? You mean she wasn't already created?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: What are you talking about? We only just finished gathering all the ingredients.
Then what was Nayuta talking about with that gene being awakened inside me?
Could it be that a Queen exists... somewhere on the surface?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Why are you being so quiet? What are you scheming?
... Wasn't your strategy to wait as long as possible?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: It was.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: But then Whaley... or Mother Whale, rather, fell right in front of this Imitation Ark.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: It's obvious that your friends will come to interfere, and the Offsprings will come to try and kill us.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: We've also confirmed the Offsprings aren't as strong as we thought.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Meanwhile, there are two of us who can transform.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: So, is there even any reason to wait?
Still... why did you need that... thing from me?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: We heard that it is essential for the birth of new life.
That's true... but that's not how it works...

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Who cares. What kind of purpose do you think this Imitation Ark serves?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: It's a type of ritual, the effect of which has yet to be proven. Even so, we're fairly confident that it will work.
*Bubble bubble bubble*
The black sphere floating in the air begins to writhe.
The Dark Matter flowing from it grows denser.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Looks like it's begun.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Until our Queen is born, we must defend this place.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: All right, Ziz. Let's go.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Huh? Me?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Yes. You and I are the heaviest hitters we have right now.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Uh...
Ziz looks nervously at Leviathan.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Ziz.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Y-yes? Wh-what is it, Levi?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: ... All this time, you've hidden yourself and suffered because of us... No, because of me.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: But you don't need to do that anymore.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: ... Thanks for saving me.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: *Gasp* L-Levi...

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Go wild out there.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: But don't die.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: G-got it!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: You as well, Behemoth.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Of course.
Ziz and Behemoth leap into the black hole in the ground.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Now then, Bahamut.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: You take care of things here.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: Certainly. With my great intellect, I will shoulder the mission of safeguarding this place.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Keep a close watch on this Young Man. Make sure he doesn't get up to any funny business.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: I just have to keep an eye on him? That's easy.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: If he interferes with the Queen's creation, you may kill him.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: Got it.
Where are you going...?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I need to shape the battlefield and tilt things in our favor.
So I'm a hostage?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Yes, you are.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: So make sure you behave. Don't go wantonly splashing your blood into the Furnace.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: You remember how Behemoth and I transformed, don't you?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Well... I did get halfway there, but anyway...

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: If you want to help with the Queen's growth, then feel free to spill your blood. I'm curious too.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Oh, by the way, the only reason you're being held hostage is because eliminating you feels iffy.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: But don't think you can do whatever you want and we won't kill you.
Leviathan also leaps into the black hole.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: I'll occupy my time reading meanwhile.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: Do not approach me, or you shall perish, Young Man.
